articles.title: Ann Widdecombe was hit on head 21 times with hammer, prosecutors say
articles.description: Joshua Kerry, 28, attacked Widdecombe while she was eating lunch at her home in Devon before stealing her wallet, prosecutors say.

articles.title: London-based civil servants offered move to No 10 North in Manchester
articles.description: London-based civil servants willing to move north have been told they will be offered relocation packages, the BBC understands.

articles.title: Row escalates in Ukraine over army chief's future
articles.description: Protesters are demanding Oleksandr Syrskyi be removed and former defence minister Mykhailo Fedorov reinstated by Friday.

articles.title: US launches fresh strikes on Iran, as Trump warns of retaliation for deaths of soldiers
articles.description: Iran says it has hit two ships in the Strait of Hormuz as well as targets in Bahrain and Jordan.
